description: Estimate impervious surface fraction from multi-band satellite imagery (Sentinel-2) using spectral indices (NDBI, NDVI, MNDWI). Supports binary classification and continuous fraction estimation, with zone-level aggregation and change detection. Use when mapping urban impervious surfaces, computing impervious ratios by watershed/admin unit, or analyzing temporal changes in built-up areas.
